title: Stay probability at a point subcube
statement: For every nonnegative integer $k$, start at the all-$+1$ point of the $k$-dimensional sign cube and apply the noise kernel with correlation parameter $1/3$. The expected value of the indicator of that point is $(2/3)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: The starting point has every coordinate equal to $+1$
